requirements.statement: On a precise Data Abort from a single-register load, the destination register remains unchanged and any specified base-register writeback is suppressed, implementing the base-restored abort model.

source_refs.locator: §A2.6.6 Effects of data-aborted instructions; Abort models

requirements.statement: In ARMv4T, ARM LDR to R15 ignores loaded bits[1:0], clears them in the branch target, and continues in ARM state.

With CP15 Control bit 15 clear, ARM946E-S ARM LDR to R15 clears loaded bit 0 and loads CPSR T from it; loaded bits[1:0]=10 are UNPREDICTABLE. With Control bit 15 set, loading T is disabled and the ARMv4-style word-aligned ARM-state target is used.

source_refs.locator: §A4.1.23 LDR description, operation, and use of R15
